name: Norris-Higgins House
address: 10806 Keswick Street, Garrett Park, Montgomery County, MD

location.how: 2.0 m west and 1.2 m north of the Google search's pin for the address, which the Google view labels with the house number; the drawn house sits under this point on the 2015 public ortho md-2014-2016 (0.152 m/px), read off a crop, not clicked to the pixel

standing.note: The 2012 and 2015 orthos show the drawn cross-gabled house; by 2018 a long addition runs west from it, on the 2024 ortho and on the Google view too (not measured; drawn: 43 ft 4 in of walls plus a 6 ft 8 in porch). The truth is the 1994 house: a method that measures today's building is not scored on it.

sheets.2: Site plan, 1" = 10'-0" (roof shown); east (front) elevation, 1/4" = 1'-0", with printed levels (first floor 0, second floor 10'-10 1/4", ceiling +9'-0", ridges 27'-4 5/8" and 28'-3", basement 6'-8" below)
sheets.5: Basement floor plan, 1/4" = 1'-0"; west elevation and reconstructed west elevation, 1/8" = 1'-0"
sheets.6: First floor plan, 1/4" = 1'-0" (dimensioned on four sides)

roof_shape: cross-gable on a two-story block (gables on the long sides meeting at a central peak, valleys between), with two ridge levels; one-story kitchen/family-room addition at the sheet left under its own lower roof; wraparound front porch roof

plan.north: up the sheet (arrow turned about 10 degrees toward the sheet's left); confirmed by the elevations (east elevation shows the front porch at the sheet right)
plan.note: Start at the outside top-left corner of the family room (sheet top), walk clockwise. Every run is printed or a difference of printed strings: top 5'-0" + 38'-4" + 6'-8" = 50'-0" (the 6'-8" is the front porch), bottom 41'-0" + 9'-0" = 50'-0" (the 9'-0" is the porch beyond the hall wall), left 10'-0" + 4'-9" + 9'-9" = 24'-6", right 18'-0" + 6'-6". The wall outline's across-the-sheet extent (43'-4") is not printed as an overall.

parlor's east wall, behind the wraparound porch
jog to the hall's east wall
hall's east wall (front door), behind the porch
kitchen's north wall, behind the side porch

length.note: 4'-9" + 10'-0" (left string): one straight wall, partly behind the side porch

excluded: wraparound front (east) porch, 6'-8" deep along the parlor and 9'-0" along the hall, with front steps
side porch in the corner between the family room and kitchen, 5'-0" x 4'-9", with steps down to the west
stoop and steps at the laundry door (south)

floors.note: Second floor covers the two-story block only (not the one-story family room/kitchen at the sheet left, and not the parlor's north-east corner, which is roof). Start at its top-left corner, clockwise. Printed on sheet 7: 25'-6" (top), 31'-9 1/8" (bottom), 24'-6" (right overall and left), 12'-4 7/8" (east wall of the north-east bedroom). The two unlabelled pieces of the right string are derived: the lower one is the hall's east wall, the same wall as the first floor's 6'-6" (the jog lines up once the sheet's 20 px registration offset is allowed for); the 2'-4" jog is the first floor's.

step down to the north-east bedroom
north wall of the north-east bedroom
east wall of the north-east bedroom
jog to the hall's east wall

length.note: printed on the first-floor plan for the same wall; sheet 7 scales 638 px

chain.label: south wall of the two-story block
west wall of the two-story block

eave.elevation: North elevation, main eave of the two-story block
eave.note: mean of the two passes' scaled readings, 22.1 and 22.42 ft. lower edge of the main roof at y 2983; first floor (printed 0) at y 5017; grade under the north wall slopes from y 5255 (west end) to 5195 (east end), mid y 5225: eave 20.34 ft above the first floor (scaled; the printed ceiling level, 19'-10 1/4", is 3 px below it) + floor 2.08 ft above grade. The cross gables' eaves are lower (about y 3980, 10.4 ft above the first floor).

ridge.note: the higher printed roof ridge, 28'-3" above the first floor, plus the first floor's height above grade scaled by both passes (1.92 and 2.08 ft, mean 2.00)

readings.elevation: East elevation (also north and south elevations, sheets 3 and 4)
East and north elevations; the south elevation shows 6'-8" too

readings.note: east (front) elevation: about 2.7 ft (floor y 4183, grade y 4450)

readings.what: main eave above first floor, scaled

overhang.note: east elevation: main roof edge to edge 5350 to 7967 = 2617 px against the printed 24'-6" wall depth, halved; north elevation gives (3992 - 3833)/2 = 0.8 ft against 38'-4"

roof.note: Eaves left unset: cross gables on the long sides, lower roofs over the one-story addition and the porch; the outline's sides do not map to the gutter runs.
roof.derive_note: cross gables on a two-storey block, a one-storey addition and a porch under their own roofs

a.note: parlor wall length; the porch wraps on along the hall (9'-0" deep there, 6'-6" long)

porches.name: side porch between family room and kitchen

passes.a: pass A: an independent reader of the 400 dpi sheets (2026-11-25), chain and heights read from crops
passes.b: pass B: a second independent reader of the same sheets (2026-11-25), not shown pass A

disagreements.pass_a: 27'-4 5/8" above the first floor (main ridge) + 1.92 ft scaled grade = 29.3 ft
disagreements.pass_b: 28'-3" above the first floor (the higher of the two printed 'roof ridges') + 2.08 ft scaled grade = 30.33 ft
disagreements.resolved: the higher printed ridge, 28'-3" (the roof's top, as lidar's peak reads it), plus the mean of the two scaled grades, 2.00 ft
the mean, 22.26 ft (both scaled on the north elevation)

flags.note: No printed overall of the wall outline across the sheet: the 50'-0" overalls include the front porch (50'-0" - 6'-8" = 43'-4", which the chain matches). Up the sheet the printed 24'-6" (left) is the outline's extent and the chain matches it.

Second floor: the drawn east wall of the north-east bedroom scales 12.66 ft against its printed 12'-4 7/8", and the step above it scales 5.36 ft against the 5.59 ft derived from the printed strings; printed values kept.

Eave height is scaled (no eave level printed) and rests on a scaled floor-to-grade offset that varies 1.8 to 2.7 ft around the house; the ridge is printed above the first floor (28'-3") plus that scaled offset.
Two ridge levels are printed on all three elevations: 27'-4 5/8" (lower) and 28'-3" (higher, used), both above the first floor.

note: Kept from pass B, with the resolutions in passes.disagreements.
